Lemma
[Every value is a regular value of $f|_{\mathcal{R}}$]

↗ def:regular-set ↗ lem:regular-set-open ↗ lem:opens-restrict-differential

Let $M$ be a smooth manifold, $f\in C^\infty (M)$, and regard its regular set $\mathcal R$ as an open submanifold. Then \[ d(f|_{\mathcal R})_x\ne 0\qquad (x\in \mathcal R). \] Thus every $c\in \mathbb R$ is a regular value of $f|_{\mathcal R}$.

Proof

↗ lem:opens-restrict-differential ↗ def:regular-set \sketch Lemma 5 gives $d(f|_{\mathcal R})_x=df_x$, which is nonzero by the definition of $\mathcal R$.

□
